judges.reason: The cleaned ciphertext has 54 letters, yielding exactly 18 groups of 3. Interpreting “先减” as -x1+x2-x3, the first groups give OHZ: -14+7-25 ≡ 20 and EGX: -4+6-23 ≡ 5 (mod 26), matching the canonical aggregate list; adding 11 then produces F and Q, matching the canonical plaintext. The supplied attempt instead uses x1-x2+x3, so it is demonstrably incorrect.
judges.depth_evidence: Each group requires letter-to-index conversion followed by alternating signed aggregation, then the resulting residue must be shifted by 11 and mapped back to a letter. The sign convention is essential and must be applied consistently across all 18 groups.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate explicitly computes alt as x1−x2+x3, but the stated rule “先减” requires −x1+x2−x3. For example, OHZ is reported as 6 by the certificate, whereas the required residue is 20; consequently its plaintext is also wrong.
